mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_mention (order_id, timeline_id, member_id, from_id, from_name, content, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{timelineId}, #{memberId}, #{fromId}, #{fromName}, #{content}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select timeline_id as timelineId, member_id as memberId, read_time as readTime from jiedan_mention where order_id = #{orderId} order by id asc
mapper.update: update jiedan_mention set read_time = #{readTime} where order_id = #{orderId} and member_id = #{memberId} and read_time is null
mapper.select: select m.member_id as memberId, count(*) as cnt from jiedan_mention m join jiedan_order o on o.id = m.order_id and o.del_flag = 0 where m.read_time is null group by m.member_id
